needs: A spell's choice between instruction lists asked as a labelled question; the AST carries no option labels, so `one_of` needs them from the card text or a generated label list.
A villainous choice (CR 701.55): each opponent in turn picks one of the options for the card to apply.

A change to one spell on the stack or to the next spell a player casts: counters it enters with, abilities and keywords it gains, its total cost, can't be countered, and changes that continue on the permanent it becomes.
Effects made at resolution on objects, players, each spell that matches including later ones, or the next matching spell, for a duration: discounts, abilities gained, plays allowed.
A rule of the game changed for a duration, made by a resolving effect: combat damage not assigned or prevented, phases skipped, permanents that phase, and the like.
Clash (CR 701.30): each clashing player reveals the top card of their library and may put it on the bottom; whether the actor won.
Voting (CR 701.38) on words, players, objects or graveyard cards, open or secret, that records votes for `g.votes()` to read; only `vote::for_permanents` exists and it records nothing.
Stickers (Unfinity): a player's sticker sheet, putting a chosen or named sticker on an object, and the ticket cost. A casual-only mechanic.
Intensity (CR 702.169): a value kept on cards that follows them through zones and is raised for each matching card a player owns. Digital-only.
Abandoning an ongoing scheme (Archenemy, CR 314.5): the scheme card leaves the game's ongoing state. A casual variant.
Secret choices and votes kept hidden until a later instruction makes them known.
Things one player does to another: heist (Alchemy, digital-only), controlling a player's next turn or combat, and exchanging life totals with them.
The exchanges past life totals and control of two permanents: ownership, text boxes, power, life with power or toughness, zones, ante, control of a set with a player, and any until a duration ends.
api: cantrip_mechanics::exchange::exchange(g, source, Exchange::.., first, second, until)

needs: Copying or retargeting a spell or ability with the new targets stated: each legal target, to a set, at random; `copy_spell` and the change-target calls only ask the player or keep them.
api: cantrip_mechanics::copy::{on_stack, on_stack_each, retarget, retarget_each}(g, player, .., NewTargets::..)?

needs: A value remembered on an object for a later read: a number, a player, a life total, counters, mana spent, an ordering of cards.
Damage from one instruction that can't be prevented (CR 615.12), a rider of that damage alone rather than a rule for the turn as `damage_cant_be_prevented` is.
Damage with a rider: excess to a player, part of it prevented, or divided by a player other than the controller.
A choice between power/toughness adjustments, with a read of each half of what was chosen.
A guess of a hidden card's quality or a player's secret choice, with a read of whether it was right.
api: cantrip_mechanics::guess::guess(g, player, source, object, filter, of)?

needs: Bidding (Forge's Bid): players raise a stake in turn until all pass, and the winning amount and player are read. Casual cards.
Seek (Alchemy, digital-only): a card chosen at random from those that match is put into hand from the library.
Looking at a player's hand and taking a card of it to do something: they play it, it goes on top, it is cast free, it is discarded.
api: cantrip_mechanics::hand::pick_from_hand(g, actor, player, source, filter, count, HandPick::..)?

needs: Life totals redistributed among players (Reverse the Sands): each gets one of the totals, chosen in turn.
A player's speed lowered with a floor; only `increase_speed` exists.
A limit on the X announced for a spell or ability, read by a rule of the announcement.
The game restarts with some cards left out (Karn Liberated), then an action happens in the new game.
Moved objects return when a duration ends, in one effect with the move (CR 610.3), for durations past the permanent leaving play.
A permanent turned face down as a stated creature, with the characteristics the AST gives.
Several different instructions as one event (CR 608.2): the generated code runs them in order, and a batch of unlike actions is what is missing. The hole stands beside the real code.
api: planned!("operation-together", Together) beside the instructions, then g.one_instruction(|g| ..)

needs: Changes to combat by a resolving effect: reassign what attacks or blocks, make a blocker block, swap blocks, only these attack or block.
An action offered to a set of players, any one or each, optionally and once each turn, with what follows when no one did.
Casting or playing on terms the cast call has no field for: a spend-as rule, a limit, a window, effects the spell gets, a group rule over what is cast together.
api: cantrip_mechanics::play::with_terms(g, player, source, CardPlay::.., cards, count, group, terms)?

needs: A reflexive trigger on what came of an action: a regeneration that happened, excess damage, a revealed quality.
A boon (Alchemy, digital-only): a trigger on the player, used up after a number of uses.
api: cantrip_mechanics::boon::create(g, source, player, times, event, condition, body)

needs: A delayed trigger that a player can stop by paying when it fires.
Any number of named piles, kept across instructions, with one chosen by a player or at random; `choose::separate` and `pile` do two piles at once.
Populate (CR 701.36) with the entry the token gets; no call for it exists.
One payment offered to each of a set of players in turn, with what follows if none paid or one did.
A cost that is not only mana paid any number of times, by one or each player, or once for each chosen object; `may_pay_times` takes mana alone.
One step for each kind of counter among objects (as Forge's AddOrRemoveCounter).
api: cantrip_mechanics::counters::each_kind(g, player, source, among, options, optional)?

needs: A counter of a chosen kind for each object: one of several, a random missing one, one per color, or one keyword counter per ability.
Phases and steps past a plain combat: combat and main together, upkeep, beginning, end, with what happens as the added phase starts.
A spell countered to a stated place, gated on what it is; `counter_to` covers the fixed places.
Control given to a set of players at once, or to a player the effect doesn't otherwise name.
Attaching chosen objects to several hosts or to a player; `attach` takes one object and one object host.
Flipping that a player may stop or that another player calls.
api: cantrip_mechanics::coins::flips(g, player, times, until_lost, may_stop, called)?

needs: One target slot across modes, the target chosen deciding the mode (CR 601.2c): 'target spell or permanent' is no announced mode.
A mode not chosen during a player's last combat: `history` reads this turn and ever, and no record of the last combat exists.
No two chosen modes may share a target.
A player other than the controller chooses the modes (CR 700.2c).
Modes the game picks at random.
A pawprint budget (CR 700.2i): modes have weights and their total is limited.
A target slot chosen by a player other than the controller (CR 601.2c, 603.3d).
A target the game picks at random among legal targets.
A set rule that assigns each target to its own filter, by a bipartite matching.
A slot's size read as it is chosen; a TargetSpec's bounds are constants or the X announced.
